Package org.dreambot.api.methods.construction

Class BuildMenu

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.BuildMenu
  • public class BuildMenu
extends java.lang.Object
    Reads and selects entries in the furniture build menu (widget 458). XPE class.

    • Method Summary

      All Methods Static Methods Concrete Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method Description
      boolean isOpen()
      Checks for the furniture menu using widget 458, child 1, or that child's first child. XPE method.
      java.util.List<java.util.List<java.lang.String>> entries()
      Gets the text for each row from components 4 through 34, with tags removed. Returns an empty list if nothing can be read. XPE method.
      int keyFor​(java.lang.String label)
      Gets the row's own key, 0 if the menu could be read but has no matching row, or -1 if it could not be read. Explicit keys take priority; otherwise, use sorted six-digit codes when present on all rows, or the one-based row position. XPE method.
      int keyFor​(java.util.List<java.util.List<java.lang.String>> entries, java.lang.String label)
      Gets the matching row's key from previously read entries. Returns 0 for a missing row or -1 when the menu could not be read. XPE method.
      boolean choose​(java.lang.String label)
      Types the entry's key without pressing Enter or waiting for the piece. Returns false and leaves the menu open when no row matches; falls back to Piece.menuKey() when the menu could not be read. XPE method.
      java.lang.String describe()
      Describes the visible entries and their keys, for example 2=Oak staircase, 1=Rug. XPE method.
      boolean close()
      Closes the furniture build menu. XPE method.
